versionNote.zh: 版本以逐运行的快照记录为准（`environment.reportedModelId`）；不填单一版本号，避免把未独立确认的值写成既定事实。
versionNote.en: Version is recorded per run as a snapshot (`environment.reportedModelId`); no single version number is claimed.

evidence.zh: harness（Codex `turn_context`）报告的 model id，记录在 phase-01 各运行的 submission.json；供应商侧快照未经独立确认。
evidence.en: Model id reported by the harness (Codex `turn_context`) and recorded in each phase-01 submission.json; the provider-side snapshot is not independently confirmed.

notes.zh: Phase 1 的 15 个任务由 Codex CLI 0.147.0 以 medium effort 执行；每题一个独立会话。运行有完整的工具调用记录，收尾审查为正常逐维度审查（非「无遥测默认遵守」）。
notes.en: The 15 phase-1 tasks were run by Codex CLI 0.147.0 at medium effort, one independent session per task. Tool-call telemetry is complete, so the runs went through the normal dimension-by-dimension audit (not the no-telemetry default).
